headline: Callahans Passage Erupts; The Latch Falls Silent
war_summary: The guns have opened along Callahans Passage, absent from our earlier editions: losses that ran at single figures now stand near three hundred eighty Colonial and two hundred seventy Warden in the past hour, and The Latch has gone to no-man's-land, the map's newest ruin. The Dead Lands keep their furnace, better than six hundred casualties a side in two hours with Callahan's Boot again the busiest work, while Stonecradle, flared since our last edition, has now given up ground — The Long Fast passed to Colonial hands in the small hours. Weathered Expanse remains the day's most scoured field, twenty-nine base actions with Necropolis fought over seventeen times; Fishermans Row follows at thirty-nine, though its guns ease. Tempest Island has woken again about Isle of Psyche and Surge Gate, Marban Hollow saw Mox taken by Colonials, and Godcrofts and Stlican Shelf stay restless, while Oarbreaker and Lykos Isle lie quiet. The ledger reads two hundred fifty-nine Colonial works against one hundred seventy-two Warden, with three in ruin at Callahans Passage, the Dead Lands and Godcrofts. It is the war's one-hundred-thirty-fourth day; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize.
